How this estimate is calculated

Net price = vehicle price + accessories + estimated insurance after NCD − rebate. Loan amount = net price − cash deposit.

Monthly payment = loan amount × (1 + annual flat rate × years) ÷ (years × 12). Interest is calculated on the original loan amount. The flat rate is not an effective interest rate.

NCD is applied to the entered insurance amount as a simplified estimate. Actual discounts may exclude taxes, fees and add-on cover. This calculator assumes insurance and accessories are financed after deducting the deposit; confirm eligible financed items with your lender.

Reference prices come from your supplied dealer sheet and the Hilux PDF dated 22 July 2026. Insurance is estimated from the dealer sheet. Prices and availability have not been independently verified. Figures are illustrative, subject to lender approval, and are not a financing offer.
